name: Smart CI
on: [pull_request]

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      backend: ${{ steps.f.outputs.backend_any_changed }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.f.outputs.frontend_any_changed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
        id: f
        with:
          files_yaml: |
            backend:
              - 'server/**'
            frontend:
              - 'web/**'

  backend:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.backend == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [{ run: 'echo running backend tests' }]
